strings.d1.s0.name: Dubai Mall
strings.d1.s0.tips: The world's largest shopping mall, with an aquarium and ice rink. An air-conditioned start to the day.
strings.d1.s1.name: Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
strings.d1.s1.tips: A tunnel aquarium inside the mall, with sharks.
strings.d1.s2.name: Social House Dubai Mall
strings.d1.s2.tips: International menu with fountain views. Lunch stop.
strings.d1.s3.name: Burj Khalifa At the Top
strings.d1.s3.tips: Floors 124-125, sunset slot (~219 AED). Book online weeks ahead. You get sunset and the city lights in one visit.
strings.d1.s4.name: Dubai Fountain
strings.d1.s4.tips: A fountain show every 30 minutes on Burj Lake. Watch for free from the Souk Al Bahar terrace.
strings.d1.b0.name: Time Out Market Dubai
strings.d1.b0.tips: Food hall at Souk Al Bahar. Lunch with plenty of choice.
strings.d1.b1.name: Sky Views Observatory
strings.d1.b1.tips: Glass walkway facing the Burj. A backup if Burj tickets are unavailable.
strings.d2.theme: Old Dubai: Al Fahidi, abra and souks
strings.d2.s0.name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood
strings.d2.s0.tips: Stone houses with wind towers. Have breakfast at Arabian Tea House and visit the coffee museum. Mornings are cool.
strings.d2.s1.name: Dubai Museum Al Shindagha
strings.d2.s1.tips: Pearl-diving history and a Creek museum in Shindagha. Air-conditioned.
strings.d2.s2.name: Dubai Creek Abra
strings.d2.s2.tips: Cross to Deira by wooden boat for 1 AED. One of the cheapest and best moments in Dubai.
strings.d2.s3.name: Deira Spice Souk
strings.d2.s3.tips: Spices, saffron and incense. Haggling is a must; paying half the asking price is normal.
strings.d2.s4.name: Al Ustad Special Kabab
strings.d2.s4.tips: Iranian kebabs since 1978, in Bur Dubai, with walls full of photos. Dubai's most famous cheap eatery.
strings.d2.b0.name: Arabian Tea House Al Fahidi
strings.d2.b0.tips: Emirati breakfast or lunch in a courtyard.
strings.d2.b1.name: Deira Gold Souk
strings.d2.b1.tips: The gold market. Browse the windows; it is next to the Spice Souk.
strings.d3.s0.name: Aquaventure Waterpark Atlantis
strings.d3.s0.tips: A huge water park on the Palm, the only cure for summer heat. Buy tickets online; mornings are less crowded.
strings.d3.s1.name: Jumeirah Mosque
strings.d3.s1.tips: Mosque tour at 14:00, guided by SMCCU.
strings.d3.s2.name: Al Fanar Restaurant Jumeirah
strings.d3.s2.tips: A 1960s-themed Emirati restaurant. Try the machboos and luqaimat.
strings.d3.s3.name: Madinat Jumeirah Souk
strings.d3.s3.tips: An artificial souk with canals. The abra tour costs 100 AED, with sunset views of the Burj Al Arab.
strings.d3.s4.name: Burj Al Arab Viewpoint
strings.d3.s4.tips: Sunset view of the sail-shaped hotel from Jumeirah Beach. Free.
strings.d3.b0.name: Pierchic Madinat
strings.d3.b0.tips: A pier restaurant over the sea. A special dinner.
strings.d3.b1.name: Etihad Museum
strings.d3.b1.tips: Museum on the founding of the UAE. Air-conditioned.
strings.d4.s0.name: Dubai Marina Walk
strings.d4.s0.tips: A marina promenade among skyscrapers. Stop for coffee.
strings.d4.s1.name: The View at The Palm
strings.d4.s1.tips: Observation terrace on floor 52 of Palm Jumeirah. You can see the palm shape from here.
strings.d4.s2.name: Nakheel Mall
strings.d4.s2.tips: The Palm's mall. An air-conditioned break.
strings.d4.s3.name: Bu Qtair Jumeirah
strings.d4.s3.tips: A former fishermen's shack turned legend. Fried fish of the day, eaten standing or on stools.
strings.d4.s4.name: JBR The Walk & Beach
strings.d4.s4.tips: The JBR seafront strip. Swim in winter, take an evening walk in summer, with views of Ain Dubai.
strings.d4.b0.name: Marina Social Dubai
strings.d4.b1.name: Ain Dubai
strings.d4.b1.tips: The world's largest observation wheel. If the weather is clear.
strings.d5.s0.name: Museum of the Future
strings.d5.s0.tips: The museum of the future, a giant ring with Arabic calligraphy. Buy online tickets weeks ahead.
strings.d5.s1.name: Dubai Frame
strings.d5.s1.tips: A golden frame separating old and new Dubai. Glass bridge, air-conditioned.
strings.d5.s2.name: Ravi Restaurant Satwa
strings.d5.s2.tips: Pakistani cuisine and Dubai's most famous cheap eatery. Order the dal and chicken karahi.
strings.d5.s3.name: Lahbab Desert Safari
strings.d5.s3.tips: In summer, go on an evening safari after 17:00 when the sand is hot. Show and BBQ, 250-400 AED.
strings.d5.b0.name: Al Mallah Satwa
strings.d5.b0.tips: Lebanese shawarma and fruit cocktails. An alternative to Ravi.
strings.d5.b1.name: Al Qudra Lakes
strings.d5.b1.tips: Artificial lakes and flamingos in the desert. Go by car instead of the safari.
strings.d6.s0.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
strings.d6.s0.tips: 1.5 hours from Dubai (E100 bus, 25 AED). See the world's largest carpet and chandeliers, free entry. Online registration is required; an abaya is provided at the entrance.
strings.d6.s1.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
strings.d6.s1.tips: Jean Nouvel's rain-of-light dome on Saadiyat Island. Air-conditioned.
strings.d6.s2.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi Cafe
strings.d6.s2.tips: Lunch in the museum cafe, beneath the dome.
strings.d6.s3.name: Qasr Al Watan
strings.d6.s3.tips: The presidential palace, with white marble and a library.
strings.d6.s4.name: Abu Dhabi Corniche
strings.d6.s4.tips: The seafront promenade. Your return bus leaves at 18:30.
strings.d6.b0.name: Emirates Palace Le Café
strings.d6.b0.tips: Gold-flecked cappuccino in the palace hotel.
strings.d6.b1.name: Yas Island Ferrari World
strings.d6.b1.tips: The world's fastest roller coaster. An alternative to the palace.
strings.d7.s0.name: Alserkal Avenue
strings.d7.s0.tips: An art gallery district in Al Quoz. Coffee and exhibitions, free.
strings.d7.s1.name: Karama Market
strings.d7.s2.name: Logma Boxpark
strings.d7.s2.tips: A modern Emirati cafe. Try regag bread (thin Emirati flatbread) and karak tea for a farewell meal.
strings.d7.s3.name: Dubai Metro Red Line Airport
strings.d7.s3.tips: Take the metro to DXB Terminals 1-3. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Karak House Jumeirah
strings.d7.b0.tips: Karak tea and Emirati breakfast. A light farewell.
strings.d7.b1.name: Jameel Arts Centre
strings.d7.b1.tips: Contemporary art by the Creek. An alternative to Alserkal.
strings.note0: Use a Nol card for the metro (Red Line from the airport to the Marina). Taxis are cheap and reliable (Careem/Uber). The E100 bus to Abu Dhabi costs 25 AED.
strings.note1: Summer brings 42-45°C and humidity: stay indoors between 10:00 and 17:00 (malls, museums, water parks). Go to the beach at 07:00 or in the evening. During Ramadan, eating and drinking in the daytime is only allowed in enclosed areas.
strings.note2: Mosque visits require long sleeves and a headscarf; abayas are provided at Sheikh Zayed. Alcohol is served only in licensed hotels and restaurants.
strings.note3: Burj Khalifa sunset tickets sell out weeks ahead, and so do Museum of the Future tickets.
strings.note4: Old Dubai is cheap and authentic: abra 1 AED, Al Ustad kebab 60 AED. Downtown and the Marina are expensive.
strings.note5: A 10% tip is common. Haggling is essential in the souks: start at half the asking price.
strings.transit.name: Nol Card
strings.transit.why_chosen: Valid on the metro, tram, buses and abra. The Silver card is the most practical.
